messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning a 3-week demo series for PLG called 'Ignite Demos'. Goal: bump 7-day activation by ~12% in a seeded cohort. Thinking gated landing + 50 free credits + a prompt-template pack + lightweight onboarding nudge flow. Need routing rules, experiment spec, and a short launch timeline. Who can help map inbound routing and cohort seeds?

sam: love it. quick q — which cohort do we target? new signups in first 14 days or first 30 days?

maya: leaning first-30-days new signups. will hold back a 10% control. also want to A/B test two nudge strategies: A) immediate full credits + promptpack, B) smaller credit + delayed promptpack (48h).

jen: i can own the landing + promptpack. will standardize tracking params: utm_medium=demo, utm_campaign=ignite23, and set user.mkt_cohort on claim. also will add GA events.

noah: i'll own routing. quick constraints: exclude enterprise/partner domains, and exclude internal emails. delivery channels = in-app inbox + email. for workspace signups we should DM workspace admins too.

luis: add me for exclude lists and infra config. i'll produce a denylist of company domains and set token-debounce rules (if user used >500 tokens in last 7d skip). also can add HMAC on invite link.

maya: proposed experiment arms (too many? open to trim):
  - control: no invite
  - arm A: 50 credits + promptpack immediate
  - arm B: 20 credits immediate + promptpack after 48h
  - arm C: 50 credits + promptpack + 3-email onboarding drip

sam: ops complexity grows with 4 arms. i'd recommend 3 arms incl control: control, immediate full (A), delayed (B). we can iterate on C if A wins.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release scheduled: 2026-04-06 16:00 UTC — landing + template bundle uploaded to s3://redwood-marketing/ignite-demos/ (staging).

jen: landing copy draft headline: "Try Redwood Inference — 50 free credits to ship your first demo". CTA: "Claim demo kit". wireframe attached in Figma. GA events: claim_click, template_download, first_10_requests. also embedding webinar recording after live events.

noah: routing v0 (yaml sketch):
```yaml
cohort: signup_age_days <= 30
exclude_domains: ["redwood.com", "enterprisecorp.com"]
bucket: mod(hash(user_id), 100)
  0-9: control
  10-54: arm_A
  55-99: arm_B
delivery_event: send_invite_v1
logging: invite_id => user_events.invite_sent
```
will push this to the routing repo and open a PR.

luis: metric gating idea: if arm_A activation surge causes >15% latency on dedicated infra we should throttle. also debounce invites for users who already used >10 requests in last 24h.

maya: timeline proposal:
  - Apr 6: landing + templates ready (staging)
  - Apr 7-8: QA + routing dry-run
  - Apr 9: soft launch to seed ~1k users
  - Apr 13: full launch to first-30-days cohort
  - Apr 27: analysis + postmortem

jen: webinar schedule: live demos Apr 10 & Apr 14 @ 11am PT. i'll record and embed on landing; signups get invite + reminder sequences.

sam: attribution notes: include invite_id in querystring and user profile; ensure server-side GA event fire for claim_click and first_requests. i'll add redis mapping for invite->user_id so we can join.

maya: action items recap:
  - jen: landing + promptpack + webinar pages + GA events
  - noah: routing YAML + PR + deliver pipeline
  - sam: attribution mapping + event instrumentation
  - luis: exclude list + debounce rules + infra safeguards
  - deploy-bot: schedule and run deploys
please ping if blocked. cc @jen @noah @luis :thumbsup:
